subject: Add server log when module load fails with busy name (#1084)
reason: The change only rewords a server log message in moduleLoad(): when OnLoad fails with ctx.module == NULL (busy module name), the log now says 'Module name is busy' instead of the generic text. The error reply to MODULE LOAD, the cleanup path (moduleFreeContext, dlclose, C_ERR), and all client-visible behaviour are unchanged on both builds, so no reply comparison, ledger, deployment-state or liveness oracle can distinguish the builds. The path is also unreachable from a compared sequence since MODULE LOAD/LOADEX/UNLOAD are refused commands. A log-text-only change needs no scenario.
